subject.title: [Feature]: Support for sandbox Docker parameters (--gpus all, --ipc=host)

question: Should OpenClaw expose host IPC for Docker sandboxes, and if so should it be a narrow explicit `sandbox.docker.ipc` break-glass field instead of generic raw Docker argument passthrough?
rationale: The remaining request changes the sandbox namespace boundary and public config contract; source inspection shows GPU support is already implemented and shipped, while IPC/raw args remain intentionally absent.

options.title: Add narrow host IPC field
options.body: Add an explicit opt-in IPC setting with validation, docs, config-hash behavior, Docker create args, security-audit coverage, and warnings, while keeping raw Docker args unsupported.

options.title: Reject host IPC in core
options.body: Document that host IPC weakens sandbox isolation and keep `sandbox.docker.gpus` as the supported high-power Docker path.

options.title: Design broader namespace policy
options.body: Pause implementation until maintainers define one policy for IPC, PID, network namespace joins, capabilities, and other dangerous Docker options.

recommendation.title: Add narrow host IPC field
recommendation.body: Add an explicit opt-in IPC setting with validation, docs, config-hash behavior, Docker create args, security-audit coverage, and warnings, while keeping raw Docker args unsupported.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest history signal on sandbox namespace hardening and current sandbox security-boundary docs/code.
